nlhdlr/quadratic/useintersectioncuts.description: whether to use intersection cuts for quadratic constraints to separate
nlhdlr/quadratic/useintersectioncuts.type: [type: bool, advanced: FALSE, range: {TRUE,FALSE}, default: FALSE]

separating/eccuts/freq.description: frequency for calling separator <eccuts> (-1: never, 0: only in root node)

separating/interminor/freq.description: frequency for calling separator <interminor> (-1: never, 0: only in root node)

separating/rlt/detecthidden.description: if set to true, hidden products are detected and separated by McCormick cuts
separating/rlt/detecthidden.type: [type: bool, advanced: FALSE, range: {TRUE,FALSE}, default: FALSE]

separating/rlt/hiddenrlt.description: whether RLT cuts (TRUE) or only McCormick inequalities (FALSE) should be added for hidden products
separating/rlt/hiddenrlt.type: [type: bool, advanced: FALSE, range: {TRUE,FALSE}, default: FALSE]

presolving/donotaggr.description: should aggregation of variables be forbidden?
presolving/donotaggr.type: [type: bool, advanced: TRUE, range: {TRUE,FALSE}, default: FALSE]

presolving/donotmultaggr.description: should multi-aggregation of variables be forbidden?
presolving/donotmultaggr.type: [type: bool, advanced: TRUE, range: {TRUE,FALSE}, default: FALSE]

constraints/nonlinear/checkvarlocks.description: whether variables contained in a single constraint should be forced to be at their lower or upper bounds ('d'isable, change 't'ype, add 'b'ound disjunction)
constraints/nonlinear/checkvarlocks.type: [type: char, advanced: TRUE, range: {bdt}, default: t]
